Metadata.Goal: Add explicit bounded auto-resume for long headless turns that pause with progress.
Metadata.Description: Continue resumable mandatory-continuation pauses inside one headless exec without appending user input.

TaskGroup.Description: Add explicit auto-resume options and bounded loop in headless exec.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Auto-resume continues paused progress to final output when possible.
